text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, I pondered heading out to 
take a breather since I had the time.
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll do some shopping.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —You there.
choice_data_list: 買い物でもしようかなあ

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Well timed. Follow Us.
choice_data_list: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by her unyielding presence, 
before I knew it, I had been led straight 
into—a sporting goods store boasting 
various top brands.
choice_data_list: えっ？

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hm... For now, I shall test the new line 
of sportswear. You, hold two of those.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Directed by her sharp gaze, I 
instinctively reached for the items as 
told... until a sudden doubt crossed my 
mind. Why am I the one helping her with 
her shopping...?
choice_data_list: Um...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What is it? You are the porter; obey with 
haste.
choice_data_list: あの……

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
There should be gloves as well—ah, these. 
Functionality, texture... satisfactory.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hey, take two of these as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The gym training gloves she pointed to 
seem to be a new release from an 
up-and-coming brand. These look great for <chrname> 
too—
choice_data_list: Wait, no! Um, why am I—
Wait, no! Um, why am I—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: To the register. We move on to the next.
choice_data_list: じゃなくて！あの、なんで俺が――
じゃなくて！あの、なんで私が――
choice_data_list_en: Never mind that! Um, why do I have to—
Never mind that! Um, why do I have to—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next place she brought me to was a 
bookstore packed with specialized racing 
literature.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Those research texts over there. Every 
volume in that training theory series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Crushed by her irresistible authority, I 
picked up one race-related book after 
another as commanded.
choice_data_list:
(Ah, this one looks interesting... Wait, 
focus!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Next.
choice_data_list: （あ、この本面白そう……じゃなくて！）
choice_data_list_en: (Oh, this book looks fun... Wait, no!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —We shall drop by that shop as well.
choice_data_list: (S-So heavy...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrying an ever-growing pile of bags, I 
chased after her while gasping for breath. 
Reaching my physical limit, I finally 
called out to stop her—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Are you not a Trainer? What use are you 
without the stamina to handle a mere task 
like this?
choice_data_list:
Well, you might have a point, but 
still...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To fully support <chrname> as a Trainer, basic 
physical fitness is indeed vital. Even so, 
that feels entirely separate from being 
dragged around like this—
choice_data_list: いや、それはそうかもしれないけど……！
choice_data_list_en: No, that might be true, but...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Endure it. —Forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One way or another, I was dragged all over 
the place. With an outrageous pile of 
luggage, I was exhausted to the point 
where my arms were trembling, but—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: Umm...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A break is permitted. We still have the 
journey back; recover that frail stamina 
of yours, even if just a little.
choice_data_list: あのぉ～……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While gratefully ordering coffee... I 
couldn't help but wonder why she chose me 
to carry her luggage in the first place.
choice_data_list: Why did you ask me to help out?
Why did you ask me to help out?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A Trainer responsible for horse girls must 
constantly broaden their horizons.
choice_data_list: どうして俺に手伝いを頼んだんだ？
どうして私に手伝いを頼んだの？
choice_data_list_en: Why did you ask me to help?
Why did you ask me to help?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The same applies to basic physical 
fitness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, I looked back on the day's 
events. By accompanying her shopping trip, 
I had gained valuable insights into new 
products and intriguing books.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I also realized just how out of shape I 
had become— Indeed, one could argue that 
this was a good learning experience... 
perhaps.
choice_data_list:
Then... could you tell me about the 
contents of that book?
Thank you, I learned a lot today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a specialized training theory book, 
but a title I hadn't read before. Since 
the chance presented itself, I wanted to 
learn more.
choice_data_list: じゃあ……その本の内容、聞いてもいい？
ありがとう、今日は勉強になったよ
choice_data_list_en: Then... could you tell me what that book is about?
Thanks, I learned a lot today.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You dare... seek teachings from We, the 
King? What insolent greed.
choice_data_list: Ah, sorry—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well. One must possess an insatiable 
hunger for knowledge, after all.
choice_data_list: あ、ごめ――

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Consider this your reward. Once I have 
finished reading it, I shall bestow it 
upon you. Work hard on the way back as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Gratitude should be demonstrated in 
action. Offer up some entertainment for 
Our amusement.
choice_data_list: E-Entertainment...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Panicking at the sudden unreasonable 
demand, my mind raced. Entertainment... 
meaning a quick party trick...?! In any 
case, something everyone knows—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: う、うまぴょい踊ります！う～うまだっち！

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Boring.
choice_data_list: F-Figures...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though my performance fell flat on its 
face, she let me rest leisurely until it 
was time to head back.
choice_data_list: で、ですよねー……
